🇲🇽✨ Pure nostalgia & drama in Monterrey! Mexico Legends edge FIFA World Legends 3-2 on pens after a jaw-dropping 5-5 thriller.  

🤩 Palienia’s opener sparks the crowd, but legends like Xavi, Del Piero, Cafu and Kluivert keep the fireworks going. Mexico’s fighting spirit shines through with Layun & Fabian leveling it up.

💢 Penalty shootout heroics from keeper Jorge Campos (save vs Vieri!) sealed the win in this epic World Cup warm-up.

🤘 Monterrey’s ready to host four matches at the 2026 World Cup.
